Jesus Christ the revolutionary different type of King. Today we celebrate the feast of Jesus Christ, King of the Universe. Jesus is a very different King. He is the King of the Truth, the King of unconditional Love, the King of Life. His teaching in the gospel every week sheds a new light on how we can live our lives better. So when we listen to Jesus in the gospel we know we are hearing the truth. Jesus always bears witness to the truth even when it would have been more advantageous in the short term not to as we have heard in today’s gospel. Jesus’ completely different concept of kingship is only recognised by those who listen to him and realise that he is the truth and that by following him we will be saved, redeemed and will enter into the kingdom of God. The Annual Glanmire Toy Appeal (formerly known as Toy Mass) is on Sun Nov 29th. The team will be collecting NEW! Toys outside the Credit Un-ion from 3pm until 4pm. There is a drop off point in Uparty or alternat ively you can drop to my house T45WF62. All toys collected are distributed within our community. As we all know the cost of living is huge and if you have a young family Christmas makes this harder. If you find you need help with t his aspect of Christmas, please contact Fr Fogarty or the relevant agencies in the strictest con- fidence. You the Community of Glanmire have always responded to this Appeal and this year the need is greater than ever. Toy Appeal Team The Ecumenical Carol Service will take place this year, in St. Mary and All Saints, Church of Ireland, Church Hill, on Sunday 6th December at 4 pm. St. Mary and All Saints has been closed for over a year for repairs and will reopen for the first time on December 6th. The new Church of Ireland Bishop, Bishop Andrew Orr, will officiate and St. Joseph's Church Choir will lead the congregation in the singing. Please come along and show support for our neighbours at this very special time of the year.
